title: ASDD Harness Feature Document
description: Feature tracker for a single slice. Validated by check-invariants.mjs.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the feature document.

slice_id.description: Identifier of the slice these features belong to.

source_tasks.description: Repository-relative path to the tasks.md file that produced these features.

features.description: List of features. May be empty for slices in discovery/spec phase.

id.description: Unique feature identifier within the slice.

user_visible_behavior.description: Description of the observable behavior from a user perspective.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the feature.

verification.description: List of verification steps or criteria.

evidence.description: Filled only when status is 'passing'. Describes what ran and the result.

depends_on.description: IDs of features that must be 'passing' before this one can start.

owner.description: Agent or worker identity owning this feature. Required when multiple features are in_progress concurrently.

scope_paths.description: Non-empty repo-relative files/directories this feature owns. Required for concurrent in_progress features.

req_ids.description: EARS requirement IDs traced to this feature.
